summary: Tested all 3 reported bugs: (1) GST stale cache in AdminPOS, (2) CGST/SGST missing on invoice, (3) hardcoded UPI on receipt. All 3 bugs verified as FIXED.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not exist (404). AuthContext calls /auth/me on page reload but it returns 404, causing all protected routes to break on page.goto() in Playwright. This is a pre-existing issue. Auth works via httpOnly cookie + /auth/refresh interceptor but only when navigating client-side (React Router). Any hard refresh of protected routes fails.

test_results.bug_1_gst_cache: FIXED - AdminPOS settings query has staleTime:0 and refetchOnMount:true. POS correctly shows CGST 9% (₹243) and SGST 9% (₹243) when item added after enabling GST.
test_results.bug_2_cgst_sgst_on_invoice: FIXED - Receipt shows CGST (9%) 243.00 and SGST (9%) 243.00 rows between Subtotal and TOTAL. Total=₹3186 = 2700*1.18.
test_results.bug_3_upi_qr_hardcoded: FIXED - /api/settings/public returns current DB value. Receipt uses dynamic upiId from shopInfo query. Changing UPI to test123@upi and saving shows test123@upi in receipt QR section.
test_results.settings_public_endpoint: PASS - GET /api/settings/public returns {upi_id: '9309782750@ybl', upi_name: 'Shahu Phataka'} without auth.
test_results.gst_disabled_no_rows: Not explicitly tested in UI but computeTotals correctly returns cgst=0 when gstEnabled=false, and pos-cgst-line only renders when gstEnabled && totals.cgst > 0.

action_items: Consider adding GET /api/auth/me endpoint to support page refreshes on protected routes (pre-existing bug, not related to current PR)
critical_code_review_comments: Missing /api/auth/me endpoint - AuthContext.js calls api.get('/auth/me') on mount but backend has no such route. This means all protected routes fail on hard page reload. Auth only works via initial login + React Router client-side navigation. User-facing impact: if a customer refreshes /order/:id they get redirected to /login.
seed_data_creation: Test POS order FW/2026-27/0062 created for GST testing (Test GST Customer, ₹3186)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bugs fixed and verified. Settings restored (UPI=9309782750@ybl, GST=OFF). Pre-existing issue: /auth/me endpoint missing means hard page reload on protected routes breaks auth. Use client-side navigation (clicking links) not page.goto() when testing protected routes in Playwright.
